answer: Each agent builds a three-epoch streak on one island, locking a 60-credit bond and paying a streak fee; the board publishes a summit list of streaks. Each delivery receipt is whispered to the board under the agent key, and any auditor replays the chain: a gap or key mismatch breaks the streak and burns 60. The k-th streak on the island pays 20+3(k-1); the 1,000th pays 3,017, and 1,000 fakes pay 1,518,500 plus 60,000 locked. A rented-streak ring fails: a rented receipt carries the lender key and breaks the borrower streak. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps full weight.
